name: Tool — Agent-to-Agent (A2A)
summary: A2APreviewTool: invoke another Foundry agent as a tool from a BYOM-routed caller.
description: Different surface from connected-agents; A2A is the tool-shaped wrapper around another agent endpoint. Requires an A2A connection or endpoint (`A2A_PROJECT_CONNECTION_ID` or `A2A_ENDPOINT`).
notes: Not in the official supported-tools list. Skips unless `A2A_PROJECT_CONNECTION_ID` or `A2A_ENDPOINT` is set — a Foundry Prompt Agent is not itself an A2A server, so self-provisioning end-to-end requires a real A2A backend outside this test.
